title: lamium maculatum var. laevigatum
intro: Lamium maculatum var. laevigatum, commonly known as spotted deadnettle, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, characterized by its heart-shaped leaves and purple flowers. Spotted deadnettle has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating wounds, reducing swelling, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of spotted deadnettle include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
